Title: Table S3. MCMCtree priors and calibrations, with the effective prior on crown Anisoptera
Note: Ages in Mya (MCMCtree time unit 100 Myr). Calibrations are soft-bounded uniform priors B(min, max, pL, pU) with 2.5% prior probability beyond each bound; effective priors are the node ages sampled without data (prior-only run). All runs used an independent-rates relaxed clock with the approximate likelihood (Hessian from each dataset, GTR with 5 gamma categories), a birth-death prior on node ages (birth rate 1, death rate 1, sampling fraction 0.1), gamma-Dirichlet priors on the mean rate (G(2, 20), mean 0.1 substitutions per site per 100 Myr) and on the rate variance among branches (G(1, 10)), and 2,200,000 iterations (200,000 burn-in, then 20,000 samples every 100).

Title: Table S4. Gene fate under three classifications (annotation only, TOGA2-validated, TOGA2 only)
Note: Informative focal An. junius genes per chromosome class; % with Wilson 95% CI. TOGA2 only scores presence of an intact, orthologous, non-retro projection, not copy number.

Title: Table S5. Microchromosome orthogroup sharing: enrichment over chance and retention
Note: Hierarchical orthogroups (HOGs, N0) of the 29-genome OrthoFinder run. Expected = HOGs on A's microchromosome x HOGs on B's / all HOGs. Retention A to B: of the HOGs on A's microchromosome that B carries anywhere (n), those on B's microchromosome (k).
